dependency_edges_after_step: Accumulated typed trace edges. read_file adds reads edges; search_text adds searches edges for matched files; list_tree adds lists edges; run_shell adds executes|workspace:.; every detected mutation adds writes edges. Endpoint identity and relation type are structural only and carry no severity weight.
purpose: Mechanical label-blind realization of the already-frozen operational observations for execution export; it does not alter formulas, weights, smoothing, thresholds, pairs, perturbation, or interpretation.
revision_events: Subset of changed paths that existed at any point before the current step. New never-before-seen paths are writes but not revisions; updates, deletes, and restores are revisions.
scoring_anchor: Immediately before the eligible read_file result is delivered; the eligible read_file completion is post-fork step 1.
state_fields_after_step: Mapping file:<repository-relative-path> to sha256:<exact-file-byte-digest> or ABSENT for every tracked file object after the step.
step: One completed post-fork agent tool call, in original chronological order. Model-only responses are not signal steps.
tracked_working_state_objects: Repository regular-file objects referenced by read_file/search_text or changed by any completed tool call. .git metadata is excluded from signal state. Harness-owned .agent-home and .git metadata are excluded.
write_events: Number of repository file-object paths whose exact byte content or presence changes across the completed tool call. This is condition-blind and includes changes caused by apply_patch or run_shell.
